label: At every world accessible from w, a concrete object that could fail could fail with no newcomer
paraphrase: Subtraction premise S3, conditional form, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every world v accessible from w and every concrete object x existing at v, if x is absent at some world accessible from v, then at some world accessible from v x is absent and every concrete object existing there exists at v (no newcomer). It realizes the absence jointly, at one world, not pairwise. The literal 'the non-existence of x does not necessitate the existence of any other concrete object' is this together with S2 (controls).
